subject: Northbridge Bank — Security review follow-ups (retention controls + compliance report pack)
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Donnelly <sarah.donnelly@northbridgebank.com>, David Chen <david.chen@northbridgebank.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 7, 2025 at 9:14 AM PST
Subject: Northbridge Bank — Security review follow-ups (retention controls + compliance report pack)
Attachments: Redwood_Retention_Controls_Overview_v1.0.pdf; Compliance_Reporting_Pack_Baseline_Contents_v0.9.pdf; Northbridge_Security_Questionnaire_Open_Items_2025-02-07.xlsx

Sarah, David —

Thank you again for the time yesterday. Per your request, attaching:

1) Redwood Retention Controls Overview (supported data classes, default TTLs by deployment mode, purge semantics, and legal hold behavior)
2) Compliance Reporting Pack (baseline contents + what’s included in the first customer-ready package)
3) Open items tracker (your questionnaire items we still owe, with owner + ETA)

Quick highlights (to keep this email self-contained):

Retention controls (what’s configurable vs. fixed in v1)
- Data classes covered in v1: request/response logs (where enabled), audit logs, traces/metrics, and select operational artifacts (e.g., report package outputs).
- Retention policy levers: TTL by data class, per-tenant policy, change history, and purge verification metrics.
- Purge behavior: scheduled, idempotent deletions; delete backlog is monitored; we can provide evidence of deletion jobs for a given time window.
- Legal hold: supported for audit logs and compliance evidence packages; hold actions are themselves audited.

Compliance report pack timeline (baseline)
- We can deliver an initial “baseline pack” for Northbridge (PDF + CSV/JSON exports) in the week of Feb 24, assuming we have your final scope for the evidence window and any specific audit-log filters (actor/event types).

A few questions so we don’t guess:
- Evidence window: is your preference last 30 days, last 90 days, or a specific date range?
- Audit log filters: do you want “all events” or a subset (admin actions, policy changes, access grants, export actions)?
- Deployment mode: are you evaluating Dedicated now, or Hosted API first (I know we discussed Dedicated as the target)?

If helpful, I can propose a 30-min working session early next week with Olga (GRC) + Marcus (SecEng) to close the remaining questionnaire items.

Best,
Naomi

Naomi Feldman
Director of Product, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference


---
From: Sarah Donnelly <sarah.donnelly@northbridgebank.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Chen <david.chen@northbridgebank.com>, Procurement Ops <procurement.ops@northbridgebank.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 7, 2025 at 12:03 PM PST
Subject: Re: Northbridge Bank — Security review follow-ups (retention controls + compliance report pack)

Naomi — thanks.

A few immediate follow-ups from our side:

1) Evidence window: last 90 days is preferred.
2) Audit log scope: please include admin actions + any tenant configuration changes (retention policy changes specifically), plus access/RBAC changes.
3) Retention defaults: for Dedicated, what is the default retention for request/response logs and traces? Are there any data classes that cannot be set below 30 days?
4) Data residency: confirm the regions where Dedicated can be pinned today (we will require US-only).

Also flagging: our procurement team asked whether the compliance report pack is included or an add-on.

If you can loop in whoever owns the questionnaire tracker on your side, we can push to close by Feb 14.

Thanks,
Sarah

Sarah Donnelly
VP, Information Security
Northbridge Bank


---
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Donnelly <sarah.donnelly@northbridgebank.com>, David Chen <david.chen@northbridgebank.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Ops <procurement.ops@northbridgebank.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 7, 2025 at 12:41 PM PST
Subject: Re: Northbridge Bank — Security review follow-ups (retention controls + compliance report pack)

Sarah — all makes sense. Quick answers inline; Marcus/Olga will add detail where needed.

(1) Evidence window
- Confirmed: last 90 days.

(2) Audit log scope
- Confirmed: we’ll include admin actions + tenant config changes (including retention policy CRUD / change history) + RBAC/access changes.

(3) Retention defaults / minimums (Dedicated)
- Defaults (Dedicated):
  - Audit logs: 365 days default (configurable; legal hold supported)
  - Request/response logs: OFF by default (when enabled, default 30 days; configurable)
  - Traces/metrics: 30 days default (configurable)
- Minimums: we enforce minimums for audit logs (cannot be set below 90 days in Dedicated) to preserve incident response and control evidence. Request/response logs (when enabled) and traces can be set lower than 30 days, but we require an explicit acknowledgment in Console/API due to debugging impact.

(4) Data residency / region pinning
- Dedicated can be pinned to US-only regions today. We’ll provide a residency summary in the compliance report pack.

Packaging / procurement (report pack)
- Lauren is on this thread; we’ve been treating the report pack as included for enterprise security reviews during onboarding, with ongoing/recurring generation as an add-on depending on frequency and retention requirements. Lauren can confirm what we can put in writing for Northbridge.

Olga/Magnus (below) — can you confirm the questionnaire close plan for Feb 14 and any items you want Northbridge to clarify?

Best,
Naomi


---
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Donnelly <sarah.donnelly@northbridgebank.com>, David Chen <david.chen@northbridgebank.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 7, 2025 at 1:22 PM PST
Subject: Re: Northbridge Bank — Security review follow-ups (retention controls + compliance report pack)

Sarah / David — adding a bit more color on (3) and the evidence we can provide.

Audit logs (Dedicated)
- Minimum retention: 90 days (enforced). Default 365 days.
- Events include: admin console actions, API key lifecycle, role/permission changes, retention policy changes, export actions, and auth-related events.
- Evidence: we can provide a time-windowed export (CSV + JSON) for last 90 days, plus a coverage summary (event types included, tenant id, region, and timestamps).

Request/response logs
- Off by default in Dedicated.
- If enabled: retention can be configured; we recommend >= 7 days for operational debugging.
- Evidence: we can provide a retention configuration export showing whether request/response logging is enabled and its TTL.

Traces/metrics
- Default 30 days; configurable.
- Evidence: we can provide a residency + retention summary, and (if requested) screenshots from our verification dashboards that show purge lag SLIs and purge job error rates for the relevant stores.

If you have specific “required controls” language from your questionnaire (e.g., “log retention must be >= X”), please point us to those questions and we’ll map exactly what’s enforced vs. configurable.

Regards,
Marcus

Marcus Lin
Security Engineering Lead
Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Donnelly <sarah.donnelly@northbridgebank.com>, David Chen <david.chen@northbridgebank.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement Ops <procurement.ops@northbridgebank.com>
Date: Fri, Feb 7, 2025 at 2:05 PM PST
Subject: Re: Northbridge Bank — Security review follow-ups (retention controls + compliance report pack)

Sarah — re: closing the questionnaire by Feb 14.

We reviewed your open items tracker this morning. The remaining items on our side break down as:

A) Evidence we can send without additional inputs (ETA: Feb 11)
- SOC 2 report (under NDA) + bridge letter (if needed)
- Subprocessor list + change notification process
- RBAC/access control description (Dedicated)

B) Evidence that requires your selections (target send: Feb 24 baseline pack)
- Audit log export: last 90 days (you confirmed) + filters (you confirmed)
- Retention configuration export + residency summary (US-only)

C) Clarifications from Northbridge (to avoid misstatements)
- Confirm whether you require “immutable logs” / WORM semantics as a hard requirement (some banks do). We do not market WORM storage in v1; we can discuss compensating controls if needed.
- Confirm whether you need evidence for Redwood internal access to customer tenants (policy + audit events) or just customer-side administrative actions.

If you confirm the two clarifications above, we can mark the questionnaire complete on our end pending delivery of the baseline pack.

Thanks,
Olga

Olga Petrov
GRC Lead
Redwood Inference

Hi team — on packaging/pricing for the compliance reporting pack.

For Northbridge’s onboarding security review, we’ll include one baseline compliance report package at no additional cost (covering the evidence window and scope Sarah outlined).

If you’d like recurring generation (e.g., monthly/quarterly) or additional customizations (extra sections, additional export formats, extended evidence windows), we can structure that as an add-on in the enterprise order form.

Happy to hop on a quick call to align on how procurement wants this reflected.

Best,
Lauren

Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Mon, Feb 10, 2025 at 4:37 PM PST
Subject: Re: Northbridge Bank — Security review follow-ups (retention controls + compliance report pack)

Olga — confirming the two clarifications:

- WORM/immutable logs: not a hard requirement for this phase (we may revisit later, but not a blocker).
- Internal access evidence: we need both (a) customer-side admin actions and (b) Redwood personnel access pathways + logging/approval controls at a high level.

If you can include that in the Feb 11 evidence set, that would help us keep the Feb 14 close date.

Thanks,
David

David Chen
Security Assurance
Northbridge Bank
